summary: Citizens Community Bancorp filed an 8-K to disclose that Andrew Schornack and associated Reporting Persons, identified in a July 29, 2026 Schedule 13D/A, requested a board seat at a July 27, 2026 investor meeting. The Board, having no vacancies after the June 16, 2026 Annual Meeting, referred the request to the Governance and Nomination Committee for evaluation. The company emphasized no assurance of appointment and reiterated fiduciary commitment to all stockholders. This reflects an activist investor seeking board representation; watch for committee decisions, potential proxy contest or settlement, and any value-maximization initiatives.
